text: Femi starts at the new agency on Monday. He sounded a bit nervous about the commute but excited overall. Remind me to text him Monday evening to see how the first day went. He's been at the old place for nearly six years, so it's a big change. His wife Joy is doing the school runs for the first week so he can get in early and make a good impression.
Kiara and her husband are viewing two flats in Leeds this weekend. They want somewhere with a garden for the dog, Biscuit.
Mohammed is retiring at the end of the month after thirty-one years at the council. There's a lunch for him sometime next week, date TBC.

Call with Kasia. Her daughter Zofia sits her A-level exams in early June and Kasia is more stressed than Zofia is. Zofia wants to study architecture at Sheffield, and her offer depends on getting an A in maths. Kasia says she's revising every evening and hardly leaves her room.
Need to book the van for the move. Ideally Saturday morning, otherwise the following weekend.
Esther got the promotion! She's now head of operations. Don't forget to send her flowers before Friday.
Alessia's son starts primary school next Tuesday. She's dreading the drop-off more than he is.
Juan mentioned he's thinking of leaving his job over the summer to go back to uni. Nothing decided yet.
Giulia's leaving drinks are off, apparently her manager convinced her to stay another six months. I should ask her how she feels about it when things calm down.

Divya is moving to Glasgow in a fortnight for the new role. She's never lived outside London. Remind me to ask Divya for her new address so I can post something. She's renting a two-bed in the West End with a colleague to start with. Her parents are driving up with her stuff the weekend before she starts, and she's having a small goodbye dinner on Saturday.
Kaito Nakamura passed his driving test this morning on the third attempt. Very relieved.
Omar's little girl graduated from nursery today. He sent a photo of her in a tiny cap and gown.
Bumped into Kenji at the station. He's just started at a law firm in Canary Wharf and works ridiculous hours. Looks shattered.
Elijah's interview at the hospital is Thursday afternoon. He's really anxious about the panel part. Text him good luck Wednesday night.
Ines and Adebayo finally got the keys to their new place! Housewarming is sometime early next month, they'll confirm.
Mia loves rock climbing and has just started bouldering twice a week. Might be a good birthday idea, she mentioned wanting new chalk bags.

Spoke to Mei about her first week as a teacher. It went better than she expected, though the Year 9s are tough. Her mum is visiting from Shanghai in late November. She asked if I knew any good dim sum places near her flat for when her mum arrives. I said I'd think about it.
Amir's dad had his retirement party on Saturday. I couldn't make it, so I must call Amir tomorrow to hear how it went.
Dong is a huge Arsenal fan and goes to most home games with his brother Rory.
Joy said the flat viewing on Elm Road was a disaster: damp everywhere and the landlord didn't turn up. She has another one Friday at noon.
Obi just got into Edinburgh for medicine! His parents are over the moon. Send him a card and maybe a voucher.

Bruno is relocating to Lisbon with work at the start of March. His wife Camila is staying here until the kids finish the school year. Bruno's flying out on the Sunday and coming back every other weekend. Camila is a bit anxious about doing the school runs and her own job on her own for a few months, and their youngest, Leo, has his first nativity play in December.
Ryan's sister Bethany has her graduation ceremony on the 14th, and the whole family is driving up to Durham for it.
Chioma has been struggling since the redundancy last month. She's applying everywhere but hearing nothing back. I should check in with her later this week, maybe take her for coffee.
Manon starts her new job at the museum tomorrow. She's been wanting to work there for years.
Emre and his partner are expecting their first in the spring. He's already building the cot.
Tobi's twins start secondary school in September. He's worried they'll be split up into different forms.
Grocery run, then return the parcel at the post office before it closes at five.
Coffee with Femi. His boss is leaving at Christmas and Femi might be asked to step up. He'd be great at it but isn't sure he wants the stress.
Kiara's cat Pepper had to have a tooth out on Wednesday. She's back home now and eating again.
Mohammed Ibrahim mentioned his wife is a keen gardener and has been after a new pair of secateurs. Good gift idea for her birthday in May.

Long chat with Kasia tonight. She's finally decided to sell the house in Croydon and move closer to her parents in Kraków, probably over the summer once the sale goes through. She's nervous about the kids changing schools, especially Tomek, who's just settled into his football team. Her brother Piotr is helping with the paperwork. I need to send her that estate agent's number before the weekend and ask her when the leaving do is.
Esther's son Caleb got his GCSE results back, all sevens and above. She's so proud.
Alessia has been offered a promotion but it would mean moving to Manchester. She has until next Friday to decide.
Remind me to ask Juan how his partner's surgery went on Monday.
Giulia's mum is retiring from nursing at the end of the year. They're planning a surprise party but haven't picked a date.
Divya, or Div as everyone at work calls her, just bought her first flat. It's a one-bed in Hackney, completion sometime in early December.
I'm helping Kaito move on Sunday. Need to bring the trolley and some extra boxes.

Omar had his final day at the bank yesterday after twelve years. Leaving drinks went late. He starts the new role with the startup in a fortnight. He's moving across from retail banking into product, which he's wanted for ages. He asked me to keep the twenty-second free for a proper celebration dinner.
Kenji's daughter Hana took her first steps this weekend. He's absolutely besotted.
Elijah didn't get the job. He took it well on the phone, but I could tell he was gutted. I should call him over the weekend.
Ines is a vegetarian and doesn't drink, so keep that in mind for the dinner.
Adebayo Okafor has his PhD viva on Tuesday. He's been preparing for months and says he can't sleep. Must message him the night before.
Mia's brother Luca is graduating from Bristol in July. She's flying back from Spain for it.
Mei and her girlfriend are moving in together at the end of the month. They're looking at places in Walthamstow.

Amir got a dog! A rescue greyhound called Toffee. He's taking a week off work to settle her in. Toffee is very timid, scared of the hoover and other dogs, so he's walking her really early in the morning. His girlfriend Kiara thinks she'll come out of her shell in a month or so.
Quick call with Dong. He said his mum is having her knee replaced sometime next week and he'll be staying with her for a bit afterwards. Remind me to check how she's getting on.
Joy has a new job at the BBC. She starts the first week of January and is thrilled.
Obi's mum is moving into sheltered housing on Thursday. He's taking the day off to help. It's been a hard few months for the family.
Bruno Schmidt hates surprises and big parties, so a small dinner is better for his fortieth.
Ryan has just been made a partner at the firm. Champagne's on him, he says, sometime next week.
Rory's moving to Berlin in early April for a two-year contract. He's learning German on Duolingo every morning.

Chioma's son Ikenna sits his eleven-plus on Saturday. Chioma says he's calm but she's a wreck. She's been doing practice papers every evening with him since September, and she's taking him for pancakes afterwards whatever happens. Remind me to text Chioma Saturday afternoon to ask how it went.
Camila mentioned she's been training for the Brighton half marathon in April. Ask her about it next time.
Manon's flat viewing got cancelled because the landlord sold the place. She's back to square one.
Emre's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is next Thursday at eleven. I need to send a card and ask if they need anything.
Remember to cancel the gym membership before the end of the month and sort out the electricity meter reading tomorrow.
Tobi's oldest, Grace, has her first university open day on Friday and her second the following weekend. He's driving her to both.
Bethany Morris finished her probation at the hospital. Permanent contract from next month. Brilliant news.

Dinner with Esther and her partner Ade on Saturday. Esther told me her brother Sam is finally moving back from Toronto in late January, and their parents are throwing a welcome home party for him the weekend after he lands. She also mentioned her niece starts nursery in the new year. Don't forget to ask Esther what Sam's into, so I can bring a small present to the party.
